title: R5-D4
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
description: As a small, red Astromech unit, R5-D4 had his first brush with galactic events on Tatooine of all places, where he almost ended up sold to Luke Skywlaker. Instead, he found another way to the Rebellion, working with Carson Teva, then found his way back to Tatooine and the service of Peli Motto. Scared and timid, the Droid was the key to The Mandalorian Din Djarin discovering Mandalore was actually safe.
